# Formatting assets

`katex/` contains the KaTeX 0.19.0 CSS, its font files, and its MIT license. They support the pre-rendered math in the reference board. The stylesheet and font files are retained unmodified from the package distribution.

Python syntax highlighting in `preview.html` was generated with Shiki 4.5.0 and its GitHub Light theme. No Shiki runtime is bundled or requested by the board. See `../TECHNICAL_CONTENT.md` for the build handoff.
